message.content:
Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that typically takes about **two months** (roughly 60–70 days). The process involves:

| Step | Approx. Time |
|------|--------------|
| Surface preparation (cleaning, sandblasting) | 10–15 days |
| Priming (sealing and corrosion protection) | 5–7 days |
| Application of the first coat of paint | 5–7 days |
| Drying time between coats | 2–3 days per coat |
| Application of the second coat | 5–7 days |
| Final inspection and touch‑ups | 5–7 days |

These figures assume a crew of several hundred workers working in shifts under favorable weather conditions. In practice, the schedule can shift due to weather, logistical constraints, or unexpected structural issues.
